title: Canonical etale internal-Hom comparison for a dualizable source
statement: Let A be a symmetric closed monoidal Grothendieck abelian coefficient category whose tensor is additive, with functorial flat resolutions and etale inverse images preserving flat objects. Let g:Y to X be any scheme morphism, and let D,P in D(X_et,A) have an exact pairing with D a left dual of P. For every N the evaluation-transpose comparison Lg* RHom(P,N) to RHom(Lg*P,Lg*N) is an isomorphism. Also RHom(P,N) is canonically isomorphic to D tensor N. The derived categories, tensor, pullback and Hom are the canonical source-library constructions; no boundedness or constructibility assumption is imposed.

proof.text: The exact pairing identifies RHom(P,N) with D tensor N, naturally in N, by the tensor-Hom adjunction and its two triangle identities. Strong monoidal derived pullback preserves the evaluation, coevaluation and triangle identities, so the pulled-back D is a left dual of the pulled-back P. Under the two dual-tensor identifications, the canonical internal-Hom comparison is the strong monoidal tensor comparison, hence invertible. Its defining evaluation equation identifies this isomorphism with the evaluation transpose rather than an arbitrary isomorphism.
